name: antigravity
title: Antigravity CLI (agy)
installScript:
set -eu
d=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh -o "$d/install.sh"
bash "$d/install.sh"
rm -rf "$d"
sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/agy" /usr/local/bin/agy
notes: GEMINI_API_KEY has no effect without "modelProvider": "gemini" in settings.json.
Usage telemetry is an account-level setting with no settings.json key; under the runtime allowlist it is denied.

The CLI updates itself in the background from its Cloud Run updater and storage.googleapis.com, with no documented switch; under the runtime allowlist the update is denied and the installed version keeps running.
storage.googleapis.com in the install allowlist reaches every public bucket, not only Antigravity's: the proxy cannot see paths inside TLS.
Observed with the runtime allowlist (1.4.12): agy also tries play.googleapis.com (usage logging) and its updater, which are denied; the model request still goes through.
Observed with a real key (1.4.12): besides the chosen model, each agy -p also calls gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, which counts toward the Gemini key's usage.
Model calls go to generativelanguage.googleapis.com through HTTPS_PROXY. The egress proxy replaces the placeholder in header values only, so the key must go in x-goog-api-key, not a ?key= parameter.

agentMode = accept-edits and toolPermission = always-proceed: agy -p edits files and runs commands, web requests and MCP tools without prompting; deny and ask rules still apply. Its automatic review (agentMode auto) is not available to API-key accounts ("--mode auto is not available for this account", 1.4.12), so the isolated VM is the boundary.

signIn: Reply with the single word: ok
